tasks.subject: Build MOQ engine and 5-section product review sheet
tasks.description:
Build first-class MOQ handling and a polished product review sheet.

Part A — MOQ System (apps/mobile/src/lib/moq.ts):
1. OrderRules type supporting: product MOQ, variant MOQ, mixed-variant MOQ, pack/carton sizes, order increments, tier pricing, sample options
2. Validation function: given rules + quantity, return valid/invalid with message
3. Tier calculation: given rules + quantity, return applicable unit price
4. Suggested quantities: given rules, return smart quick-buy amounts
5. Pack display: given carton rules, show '5 cartons × 24 pieces = 120 pieces total'

Part B — Product Review Sheet (apps/mobile/src/components/marketplace/ProductReviewSheet.tsx):
A bottom-sheet native review with 5 sections:
1. Product identity: image, translated title, marketplace, supplier, data status badge
2. Variants: image-linked color/size/material selection, variant price, availability
3. Quantity & MOQ: minimum qty, pack size, increment, mixed-variant rules, applicable tier, validation message
4. Costs: goods subtotal, China domestic delivery (known/pending), service fee, international shipping (estimated/pending), duties (included/pending), amount payable now, remaining to confirm. NEVER show precise total when weight/charges unknown.
5. Actions: primary 'Add N pieces to cart', secondary 'Ask about smaller quantity'

Part C — Update SmartProductForm to use MOQ engine and link to review sheet.

Use existing design tokens, types from @/types, cart from @/store/cart.
tasks.objective: MOQ as first-class feature with proper validation, tiers, and a beautiful 5-section review sheet
acceptance: Unknown costs shown as pending not fake numbers
tasks.output: MOQ engine (apps/mobile/src/lib/moq.ts): OrderRules covering product/variant/mixed MOQ, pack+carton sizes, increments, tier pricing, sample options; validateMOQ with all-constraint-satisfying one-tap suggestions (nextValidQuantity via LCM stride); calculateTierPrice with inclusive boundaries; getSuggestedQuantities; formatPackDisplay matching the spec string exactly (incl. multi-level cartons×packs×pieces and singular/plural); createDefaultRules from Product; getVariantPrice; isAtTierBoundary. ProductReviewSheet: 5 numbered sections (identity w/ data badge, image-linked variants w/ stock, quantity & MOQ w/ facts panel + stepper + quick chips + pack math + tier badge + validation fix button, honest costs w/ Pending badges for unknown international shipping & duties, actions w/ 'Add N pieces to cart' + 'Ask about smaller quantity'); wired to @/store/cart addItem, staged reviewSheet/moq i18n keys with graceful English fallback via ts() helper. SmartProductForm: MOQ-aware quantity (floor at MOQ, engine-driven quick chips, inline validation + suggested fix, tier price line) and a 'Review full costs & MOQ details' trigger opening ProductReviewSheet. Verification: 42/42 runtime tests on the compiled engine (below-MOQ rejection, pack math, tier boundaries 95→96→479→480, mixed-variant rules, caps, multi-level packs); full-project tsc exit 0 with the app's pinned TypeScript 6.0.3.
